opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as a chance to capture Bitcoin-like opportunity, calling it “a chance to take advantage of that same error now” through the company OneCoin. He then supplies reassurance that it is not deceptive, relying on records and the claim that “there is 485 000 people who has joined this trend already.” The displayed page reinforces that pitch with “OneCoin the next Bitcoin?” and a “Sign up” pathway, alongside participation and mining claims. Viewers are also urged to take the next step directly: “simply contact me at the number that's on the screen.” Together, these assurances and recruitment prompts encourage participation without substantiated evidence in the supplied content establishing the claimed value or legitimacy.
